integrity: Exact integer verifier enumerates all allowable negative-definite supports. Completeness of geometric negative curves is proved by adjunction and Bezout; no independent audit or priority certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The full count is for the minimal resolution of a one-nodal cubic over an algebraically closed field, not for arbitrary singular cubic types or arithmetic twists. The chamber/support bijection and ordinary smooth-cubic count were established previously. The earliest cited source treats generalized del Pezzo cones, not this exact chamber count. An equivalent calculation may exist in uninspected specialist tables or supplements.
title: Zariski-chamber spectrum of the one-nodal cubic's minimal resolution
